observations: Photo 0 shows a white standing hair dryer with a dome-shaped hood, mounted on a black telescopic stand with a four-legged base and wheels.
The hood has a chrome or dark tinted transparent front opening, and a blue and black sticker on top with the word 'INNOVATED' and 'Pro' visible.
Photo 1 shows the same unit from a side angle, revealing the black handle on the side of the hood and the power cord coiled around the stand.
The stand appears to be adjustable in height, with a locking mechanism visible.
The floor is tiled, and the background includes salon equipment like a white trolley and a yellow pedicure chair.
No visible cracks or damage to the hood or stand in either photo.
The seller mentions 'mango oval shape' and 'double elements', but these are not visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Quality standing hair dryer with a mango oval shape
claims.evidence: The shape is oval, but 'mango' is subjective and not visually verifiable; no photo shows a mango-shaped profile.
Photo 0 and photo 1 show no visible cracks, chips, or damage to the transparent front panel.
The internal heating elements are not visible; this claim cannot be verified from photos alone.

risks.risk: The unit may not be functional or may have electrical issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit turned on, with heat and airflow, and the control panel in operation.

risks.risk: The stand may be unstable or the height adjustment may be faulty.
risks.proof: A close-up of the height adjustment mechanism and a video showing the stand being adjusted and locked.

risks.risk: The internal heating elements may be damaged or missing, despite the 'double elements' claim.
risks.proof: An internal view of the hood or a video showing the heating elements glowing when powered on.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly single-element or non-functional

proof_requests: Video of the unit turned on, showing heat and airflow.
Close-up of the height adjustment mechanism and a demonstration of its use.
Internal view or video of the heating elements when powered on.
Clear photo of the control panel and any switches or dials.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a standing hair dryer, but key functional claims (like 'double elements' and operational status) cannot be verified from the current photos. Hidden risks related to functionality and stability require proof before pricing can be determined.
